title: Welcome to The Financial Autopsy
subtitle: Why I started The Financial Autopsy, and what you can expect to read here.
summary: These articles will explore how businesses make money, what drives their performance and how changes around the world can affect their prospects.
content:
Back when I was still in university, I had to select a local restaurant chain as the focus of an assignment. A decade on, the exact restaurant I’d chosen escapes me now, but I do recall having eaten there often enough to feel comfortable with the choice. At the very least, all the research gave me an excuse to go back for lunch.

But once I started leafing through its financial statements and found myself reading about property leases, franchise fees and the costs of opening new outlets, I started wondering how all these things fitted together. And strangely, I remember enjoying that process more than I expected: getting to know what was happening behind a business I was intimately familiar with, asking questions.

That curiosity has stayed with me through my subsequent years in equity research and asset management. But I’d never really had a space of my own (outside work, of course) to really speak up, to share my insights and what I was learning along this journey. Until now.

That’s where The Financial Autopsy comes in. Morbid, perhaps, but akin to what I already do on a regular basis: taking a financial result apart and examining each and every figure closely to piece together how every single decision and extenuating circumstance led here. And more crucially, what the future might behold. Dramatic, I know.

These articles will explore how businesses make money, what drives their performance and how changes around the world can affect their prospects. Hopefully, you can take away something useful to consider as you form your own views.

Whether you are already managing a portfolio, or considering your first investment, or perhaps simply wanting to understand how businesses and our economy work, wherever you’re starting from, you’re welcome here. And hopefully, I can learn something from all of you as you learn from me.

Thanks for stopping by, and I hope you enjoy reading along.
